nodes.label: Hosted Page Hardening (S-157 / 0.5.1 impl B)
nodes.rationale: Replaces script-src unsafe-inline with SHA-256 hash-pinned CSP and base-uri/form-action none, scopes Hosted-UI token storage to sessionStorage with one-time legacy migration, escapes </script> in embedded JSON via safeJsonEmbed, and adds nosniff/referrer headers on GET /.
